title: Tail answer with bounded index
statement: For a Boolean mode, define the value at a natural number $r$ to be the tail answer at index $r$ when $r<5$, and to be false when $r\ge 5$.
caveat: The payload does not define the tail-answer function, so its meaning at indices below five is left unspecified.
